additional_info.subject: ID0477365-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/26] Monitoring system and SCB Malfunction. CRM:02888000592
additional_info.body:
Hi Thibaut, good afternoon.
Our development team fixed the issue. What happened was that the configuration was not updated correctly to the cloud.
He mentioned that a simple "Load configuration" in SCB got the state restored.
If you find this issue again, please do this step and if it doesn't work, report to us again.
Since the issue has been resolved, I will close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
